letter.subject: Request to Opt Out of Arbitration and Cancel Purchase Protection Plan
letter.body:
To FlexPay Financial, Inc.

[Your name]
[Your address]
[Date]

I am writing to formally opt out of the binding individual arbitration clause as stated in Section 11 of my Retail Installment Agreement, signed on [Date of signing].

Additionally, I wish to cancel the FlexPay Purchase Protection Plan, as permitted by Section 3 of the Agreement. Please confirm that this plan has been removed from my account and that no further charges for it will be applied.

Please send confirmation of both actions to my address above.

Sincerely,
[Your name]

text:
FLEXPAY RETAIL INSTALLMENT AGREEMENT
Merchant: VoltCity Electronics   Purchase: Lumio X15 laptop   Purchase price: $1,200.00

TRUTH IN LENDING DISCLOSURES
Annual Percentage Rate: 29.99%   Amount Financed: $1,249.00   Total of Payments: $1,557.00
Payment schedule: 18 monthly payments of $86.50

1. PROMISE TO PAY. You promise to pay FlexPay Financial, Inc. ("FlexPay") the Total of Payments in 18 monthly installments of $86.50, beginning 30 days after the purchase date.

2. ORIGINATION FEE. An origination fee of $49.00 is added to the Amount Financed and is non-refundable.

3. PURCHASE PROTECTION PLAN. You are enrolled in the FlexPay Purchase Protection Plan for $4.99 per month for the life of the loan. This plan is optional. You may cancel it at any time by calling FlexPay. If you do not cancel, the charge will be added to each monthly payment.

4. AUTOPAY. Payments are made automatically from your linked bank account. If a payment is returned for any reason, a returned payment fee of $30.00 applies.

5. LATE PAYMENTS. If a payment is more than 10 days late, a late fee of $40.00 will be charged.

6. DEFAULT. If you miss two (2) consecutive payments, FlexPay may declare the entire unpaid balance immediately due and payable, and may report the default to credit bureaus.

7. PREPAYMENT. You may pay off all or part of the balance at any time without penalty. Interest is charged only on the outstanding balance, so paying early reduces the total you pay.

8. MERCHANT RETURNS. If you return the item to the Merchant, your loan is not cancelled until FlexPay receives the refund from the Merchant. You must keep making payments until then.

9. COMMUNICATIONS. You agree that FlexPay and its partners may contact you by phone, text message, and email, including with marketing offers, at any number you provide.

10. CHANGES. FlexPay may change the terms of this Agreement, including fees, as permitted by law, by giving you notice.

11. ARBITRATION. Any dispute shall be resolved by binding individual arbitration. You may opt out of arbitration by sending written notice within 30 days of signing.

Borrower Signature: ____________________   Date: __________

clauses.quote: You promise to pay FlexPay Financial, Inc. ("FlexPay") the Total of Payments in 18 monthly installments of $86.50, beginning 30 days after the purchase date.
clauses.title: Total cost is higher
clauses.meaning: You are borrowing $1,249.00, but you will pay back $1,557.00 over 18 months.
clauses.whyItMatters: The $1,200 laptop will cost you an extra $357.00 in interest and fees if you pay it off over 18 months.
clauses.whatToDo: Consider paying off the loan early to reduce the total interest paid.

clauses.quote: An origination fee of $49.00 is added to the Amount Financed and is non-refundable.
clauses.title: Non-refundable fee
clauses.meaning: You pay a $49.00 fee just for getting the loan. This fee is added to the amount you borrow.
clauses.whyItMatters: You are paying interest on this $49.00 fee for 18 months. It increases your total cost.
clauses.whatToDo: Ask if the origination fee can be waived or reduced.

clauses.quote: You are enrolled in the FlexPay Purchase Protection Plan for $4.99 per month for the life of the loan. This plan is optional. You may cancel it at any time by calling FlexPay. If you do not cancel, the charge will be added to each monthly payment.
clauses.title: Optional add-on by default
clauses.meaning: You are automatically signed up for a $4.99 monthly protection plan. You have to call to cancel it.
clauses.whyItMatters: This adds $89.82 to your total cost over 18 months if you do not cancel it. It is not part of the advertised loan payment.
clauses.whatToDo: Call FlexPay immediately to cancel the Purchase Protection Plan if you do not want it.

clauses.quote: If a payment is more than 10 days late, a late fee of $40.00 will be charged.
clauses.title: High late fee
clauses.meaning: If your payment is late by more than 10 days, you will pay an extra $40.00.
clauses.whyItMatters: This fee is almost half of your monthly payment. Missing a payment can quickly make the loan more expensive.
clauses.whatToDo: Set up reminders to ensure payments are made on time.

clauses.quote: If you miss two (2) consecutive payments, FlexPay may declare the entire unpaid balance immediately due and payable, and may report the default to credit bureaus.
clauses.title: Entire balance due on default
clauses.meaning: If you miss two payments in a row, FlexPay can demand you pay the entire remaining loan balance at once.
clauses.whyItMatters: You could owe hundreds or thousands of dollars immediately. This will also damage your credit score.
clauses.whatToDo: Contact FlexPay immediately if you anticipate missing a payment.

clauses.quote: You may pay off all or part of the balance at any time without penalty. Interest is charged only on the outstanding balance, so paying early reduces the total you pay.
clauses.title: No prepayment penalty
clauses.meaning: You can pay off your loan early without extra fees. Paying early saves you money on interest.
clauses.whyItMatters: This is a good feature. You can reduce the total cost of the loan by paying more than the minimum or paying it off sooner.
clauses.whatToDo: Pay extra whenever you can to reduce the total interest.

clauses.quote: If you return the item to the Merchant, your loan is not cancelled until FlexPay receives the refund from the Merchant. You must keep making payments until then.
clauses.title: Returns don't cancel loan
clauses.meaning: Returning the laptop to VoltCity Electronics does not automatically cancel your loan with FlexPay. You must continue making payments until FlexPay gets the refund from VoltCity.
clauses.whyItMatters: You could be making payments for an item you no longer have. There could be delays between your return and FlexPay receiving the refund.
clauses.whatToDo: If you return the item, confirm with both VoltCity and FlexPay that the refund process is underway and when your loan will be closed.

clauses.quote: Any dispute shall be resolved by binding individual arbitration. You may opt out of arbitration by sending written notice within 30 days of signing.
clauses.title: No court, only arbitration
clauses.meaning: You agree to resolve any disputes with FlexPay through private arbitration, not in court. You can choose not to agree to this within 30 days.
clauses.whyItMatters: Arbitration can limit your legal options and prevent class action lawsuits. You lose your right to a jury trial.
clauses.whatToDo: Send a written notice to FlexPay within 30 days if you want to keep your right to go to court.

terms.plain: This is the yearly cost of borrowing money, including interest and some fees, expressed as a percentage.
This is the total amount of credit provided to you, which is $1,249.00.
This is the total amount you will pay back over the life of the loan, which is $1,557.00.
This is a fee of $49.00 charged by the lender for processing your loan.
This means any disagreements will be settled by a private arbitrator, not in court, and you cannot join a group lawsuit.
